attributes.cardDescription: List an owned collection item for sale at a given price, denormalizing the seller and product from it.
attributes.readMe:
## Create Listing

The spec's `CreateListing` tool. Marks an owned `CollectionItem` for sale by writing `listedAt` (the event-fact `forSale` derives from), and creates the `Listing` itself with price/shipping and the seller/product denormalized from the item.

### No matrix concept existed

Confirmed absent from all 590 tracker rows — the matrix has no neutral Listing concept at all (`l05-5-cm-property-listing` is property-specific), so this is a pure new command against a pure new card.

### Example

`linkedExamples` points at the command's natural target: `CollectionItem/aj1-lost-and-found-105`.

### `forSale` is an event fact, not a boolean this command sets directly

Writes `listedAt`, never a stored flag — matching `collection-item.gts`'s own rule for `verified`: a threshold flag is a computed read of the date something happened, so it cannot drift from the listing that caused it.
